attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.text: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

rules.label: Tera
rules.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Drakloak

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

text.flavor: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

text.name: Dreepy
text.flavor: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

text.name: Dusknoir

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

text.flavor: It comes and goes between this world and the afterlife. People fear this Pokémon because it is said to suck in lost spirits and take them along.

text.name: Dusclops

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

text.flavor: Dusclops's true form is said to be a bright red eye burning within its body, but no one has ever seen such a thing.

text.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Come and Get You
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Duskull from your discard pile onto your Bench.

text.flavor: Duskull's victims suffer an intense chill as the Pokémon siphons their life-force away, glaring at them with its bright red eye all the while.

text.name: Budew

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

text.flavor: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flip the Script
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Cruel Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Genesect

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: ACE Nullifier
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, your opponent can't play any ACE SPEC cards from their hand.

text.flavor: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

text.name: Hawlucha

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

text.flavor: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

text.name: Munkidori

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

text.name: Iono
effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Professor's Research
effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Arven
effect: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Brock's Scouting
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or 1 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Hilda
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Jamming Tower
effect: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) have no effect.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

text.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Counter Catcher
effect: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.
Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Night Stretcher
effect: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
This card cannot be used in official tournaments.

text.name: Air Balloon
effect: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {Colorless}{Colorless} less.

rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

text.name: Luminous Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to has any other Special Energy attached, this card provides {Colorless} Energy instead.

text.name: Neo Upper Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.
If this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

rules.label: ACE SPEC
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
